responsibilities.label: Morning briefing
responsibilities.prompt: Prepare my morning briefing from my selected connected accounts: today's agenda, priority messages, deadlines and outstanding follow-ups. State unavailable sources. Do not change source systems unless my policy and standing instructions authorize it.

responsibilities.label: Priority alerts
responsibilities.prompt: Check my selected email accounts for newly important messages since the last successful check. Apply my priority contacts, quiet hours and interruption preferences. Notify only on meaningful new information; do not repeat previous alerts.

responsibilities.label: Calendar conflicts
responsibilities.prompt: Check for new or changed conflicts across my selected calendars. Propose resolutions; apply changes only under my effective Flolah policy and standing instructions. Do not repeat unchanged conflicts.

responsibilities.label: Deadline tracking
responsibilities.prompt: Check my selected email and file sources for new, revised or resolved deadlines. Preserve source references and timezone. Ask about ambiguous dates before creating commitments. Report only meaningful changes.

responsibilities.label: Follow-up tracking
responsibilities.prompt: Review the threads I have asked you to follow up. Close resolved threads, remind me about due replies, and send only when my effective policy and standing instructions authorize the exact recipient and content. Avoid duplicate follow-ups.
